title: First Ping Roulette
oneLiner: A playful roulette that picks one dormant friendship, shows how long it's been silent, and hands you a low-cringe first line plus a printable weekly mission card.

sourceSignals.title: Friend-app guides and 20s friendship-effort posts keep multiplying
7-year solo-living essay: loneliness is managed with routines and initiating contact

stitchPrompt: Create a playful reconnection toy called "First Ping Roulette" for people who keep reading "reach out first" advice but never do it. The app is based on observed user pull: friend-making app guides and solo-living essays repeat that friendship after your 20s requires initiating contact repeatedly ("먼저 연락하고 거듭 얼굴을 비춰야"), yet people only read and save the advice. The app should use a roulette-ritual mechanic around the trigger moment "an empty weekend evening after seeing a group photo" and make the first screen communicate "이 친구와 마지막 대화: 217일 전". Use the user's own language: "오랜만에 연락하면 어색하지 않을까?". Build the core workflow around a contact wheel with silence-days counters and three tone-choice first lines, and produce the sent first message plus a printable weekly mission card with a streak. Required sections: contact wheel with silence counter, spin reveal moment, three first-line drafts, send/skip log with streak, printable weekly mission card. Emotional pressure to make visible: 외로움 — friendships quietly expiring while you wait to be contacted. Design direction: use the playful-experimental profile with a bold but warm composition, one vivid accent, tactile spin interaction, and a shareable reveal moment. Avoid generic dashboard framing; make the main interaction feel like letting the wheel take the blame for texting first.
